-- tags: propositional_logic and
example (p q : Prop) : p ∧ q → p ∨ q := by
  intro h
  exact Or.inl h.left

-- tags: equality functions
example {α : Type} {a b c : α} : a = b → b = c → c = a := by
  intro hab hbc
  exact (Eq.trans hab hbc).symm

example {α β : Type} (f : α → β) {a b : α} : a = b → f b = f a := by
  intro hab
  cases hab
  rfl

-- tags: natural_numbers rewriting relations
example (n : Nat) : n ≤ Nat.succ n := by exact Nat.le_succ n
example (n m : Nat) : m + Nat.succ n = Nat.succ (m + n) := by exact Nat.add_succ m n
example (n : Nat) : n ≤ Nat.succ n := by exact Nat.le_succ n

-- tags: propositional_logic negation
example (p : Prop) : p ∧ True → p := by
  intro h
  exact h.left

-- tags: propositional_logic or
example (p q : Prop) : p ∨ q → p ∨ q := by
  intro h
  exact h
